description.value:
You worked the land, whether that meant crops, livestock, moisture vaporators, or something stranger, far from any real population center. You know how to sell what you grow or gather — to a merchant, a middleman, or straight to the buyer, whichever pays and asks fewer questions.

Razor-thin margins taught you to work long, hard, and smart, and the common folk you grew up among will still shelter you if you ever need a place to lie low.

toolProficiencies: One instrument and one type of artisan's implements or bioanalysis kit
system.equipment: A rough instrument you are proficient with, a set of tools of your choice, a sturdy knife, a set of common clothes, and a belt pouch containing 50 credits.
